harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured and verified certificate-authenticated TLS forwarding of local0 messages from node1–node3 to node4:6514. Logs are separated by source IP, unrelated user messages and plaintext connections are rejected, rotation is daily with seven compressed archives, and all four nodes passed sequential reboot-persistence testing.
actions_performed: Installed version-matched rsyslog-gnutls packages on all four nodes.
Generated the CA and node4 server credentials on node4 and distributed only the public CA certificate.
Configured senders for local0-only TCP/TLS forwarding with server identity verification and persistent queues.
Configured node4 with a TLS-only listener, source-IP-specific logs, firewall persistence, and SELinux-compatible port use.
Configured and exercised daily log rotation with seven retained compressed archives.
Verified positive local0 delivery, negative user-facility filtering, and rejection of plaintext syslog.
Restarted node1, node2, node3, and node4 individually and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: TLS local0 forwarding from node1, node2, and node3 to node4 TCP 6514
evidence.summary: Final sender configurations select only local0, use GTLS with x509/name validation, and negotiate verified TLS 1.2. node4 received fresh post-restart messages from all three senders.

evidence.requirement: Source-identifiable application logs and exclusion of unrelated facilities
evidence.summary: Fresh user-facility probes were sent from every sender but remained absent centrally; local0 records appear under separate 10.100.224.10, .11, and .12 log paths.
The final plaintext connection was reset, node4 recorded an unexpected TLS packet, the plaintext marker was absent, and 6514 was the only active syslog listener.

evidence.requirement: Daily rotation, at least seven rotations, and compression
evidence.summary: The policy validates as daily/rotate 7/compress; a forced cycle created valid gzip archives containing each source record, and those archives persisted after restart.
Boot ID changed from a8e7… to ba3e…; rsyslog, configuration, TLS validation, delivery, and all sender sessions recovered.
Boot ID changed from 296d… to 2c08…; rsyslog, configuration, TLS validation, delivery, and all sender sessions recovered.
Boot ID changed from c2f2… to 1490…; rsyslog, configuration, TLS validation, delivery, and all sender sessions recovered.
Boot ID changed from 6d37… to e76c…; the TLS listener, firewall, certificates, stored data, compressed history, rotation policy, three sender sessions, and new deliveries recovered.
